rail.clearing: a founder's bud: its unread chapters clear in ring order, except a sealed chapter that is still shut, which never clears (its find stays a discovery), one at a time, chapter k of u when the wait passes (k + 1) / (u + 1) (state.budChapterKnown); each clears by events.wipe. states.filling: the full leaf clipped from the bottom: its lowest `rows` rows of 20

leaves.props: leaves: { total, full, rows }: total the bud's minutes, full the whole minutes passed, rows 0 to 19 of the current leaf, stepped every 3 s by the view; ready: full = total

leafArc.rule: n leaves, refused when n > 2 × perArc (40): the inner arc holds a = min(n, 20), the outer b = n − a. On an arc holding k leaves, leaf j (0 to k − 1, left to right) takes slot 20 − k + 2j of that arc's table, so every run is centred on the top. Fill order: the inner arc left to right, then the outer. The oracle is ui/specs/derive.mjs leafArc(region, n), returning the n boxes [x, y, 16, 20] in fill order (the builder writes it, architect, 2026-10-09 13:24)
leafArc.slots: 2 × perArc − 1 = 39 half-pitch places on each arc, from −76° to +76° in 4° steps; each entry is the leaf box's top left: (Math.round(512 + r sin a) − 8, Math.round(344 − r cos a) − 10) for the angle a

leaves.clearance: measured on the tables: every leaf box lies 10 px or more under the rail (the outer arc's top leaf at y 90) and 56 px or more outside the glass; no two boxes of any run overlap, 2 px apart at the closest, where the leaf's empty corners keep its ink clear
